title: F-GC21P1-R1 Exact Accepted Bottom Interface Exchange Result Independent Qualification
qualification_questions: Does the accepted bottom-interface exchange result contain only accepted-path exchange, excluding rejected full/half/retry trials?
Does two-half acceptance publish the sum of accepted half exchanges while terminal flux comes from the accepted terminal half?
Does canonical interval aggregation sum accepted substep exchange and refuse publication for incomplete intervals?
Does missing/nonfinite interface-exchange information fail closed instead of fabricating a result?
Is the backend sign/time integration generic: outward native exchange = -bottom_flux * accepted step duration, with no day/calendar conversion assumption?
Did R1 restore the two baseline REAL equality predicates exactly rather than changing production semantics to satisfy warning policy?
Are O0 and O2 independently observed outputs identical?
Are hard mass-conservation and all 30 architecture invariants preserved without adverse delta?
independence_requirements: Use a newly authored F-VQ63 test/runner rather than invoking the owner runner as the qualification decision.
Pin exact owner authority, source blobs and governance authority.
Reproduce core behavior with test scenarios independently selected from the owner test harness.
Treat the owner test as supporting evidence only; F-VQ63 must fail closed on its own checks.
Do not modify production source in this branch.
hard_constraints: Mass conservation is absolute; no tolerance relaxation may qualify a defect.
No production groundwater-coupling, canonical-admission, crash-recovery, distributed-runtime or throughput claim.
Any production-source delta from the exact owner authority blocks qualification.
